title: Closed-Form Linear-Probe Dataset Distillation for Pre-trained Vision Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.07194v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Dataset distillation compresses a large training set into a small synthetic set that preserves downstream training utility. While most existing methods target training networks from scratch, modern visual transfer learning often uses frozen pre-trained encoders followed by lightweight linear probing. Existing distillation methods for this setting either unroll iterative linear-probe updates with trajectory-based gradient matching, or rely on closed-form formulations originally designed for from-scratch training with neural-tangent-kernel (NTK) approximations. Neither route exploits the fact that frozen-feature linear probing admits a closed-form solution determined directly by the pre-trained features themselves, with no infinite-width approximation and no inner-loop trajectory. We propose Closed-Form Linear-Probe Dataset Distillation (CLP-DD), a bilevel formulation that computes the linear probe induced by the synthetic set wi

translated_title: 面向预训练视觉模型的闭式线性探针数据集蒸馏
translated_abstract: 数据集蒸馏将大型训练集压缩为一个小型合成数据集，同时保留下游训练的效用。尽管大多数现有方法针对从头训练网络，但现代视觉迁移学习通常使用冻结的预训练编码器，随后进行轻量级的线性探测。针对这一设置，现有蒸馏方法要么通过基于轨迹的梯度匹配展开迭代式线性探针更新，要么依赖最初为从头训练设计的、采用神经正切核（NTK）近似的闭式公式。这两种路线都没有利用这样一个事实：冻结特征上的线性探测本身就存在闭式解，该解直接由预训练特征决定，无需无限宽度近似，也无需内循环轨迹。我们提出了闭式线性探针数据集蒸馏（CLP-DD），这是一种双层优化公式，用于计算由合成数据集诱导的线性探针……
tldr: 提出CLP-DD方法，直接利用冻结预训练特征线性探测的闭式解，通过双层优化计算合成数据集诱导的线性探针，无需无限宽度近似或内循环轨迹，实现面向预训练视觉模型的高效数据集蒸馏。
en_tdlr: Proposes CLP-DD, a bilevel closed-form dataset distillation method that directly exploits the closed-form solution of linear probing on frozen pre-trained features, eliminating the need for infinite-width approximations and inner-loop trajectories.
